/hr/ghcr.io-kubereboot-charts-kured.doc: Kured (Kubernetes REboot Daemon) is a Kubernetes add-on that automates the process of rebooting nodes in your cluster. It integrates with the underlying operating system's package management system to identify when a reboot is necessary, and performs the reboot in a safe and controlled manner to minimize disruption to your applications.

repos:
  - id: /.*/
  - id: /^git\.mapanare\.net/(seniordevops/infra|mapanarelabs/infra-gcp|mapanarenet/infra-opnsense|mapanarenet/infra-sso)$/
    allowed_overrides: [workflow]
    allowed_workflows: [terragrunt]
    apply_requirements: [mergeable]
workflows:
  terragrunt:
    plan:
      steps:
        - env:
            name: TG_ENV
            command: '[ "$BASE_BRANCH_NAME" = main ] && echo prod || echo develop'
        - env:
            name: TF_VAR_credentials
            command: 'echo "/tmp/gcp-$${TG_ENV}.json"'
        - env:
            name: TG_TF_PATH
            command: 'echo "$${ATLANTIS_TERRAFORM_DISTRIBUTION}$${ATLANTIS_TERRAFORM_VERSION}"'
        - env:
            name: TF_IN_AUTOMATION
            value: "true"
        - env:
            name: TG_LOG_FORMAT
            value: bare
        - run: &credentials
            command: |
              umask 077
              printf '%s' "$GCP_SDLC_CREDENTIALS" > /tmp/sdlc-mapanarelabs.json
              if [ "$TG_ENV" = prod ]; then printf '%s' "$GCP_PROD_CREDENTIALS"; else printf '%s' "$GCP_DEV_CREDENTIALS"; fi > "$TF_VAR_credentials"
            output: hide
        # Re-init every run: .terragrunt-cache persists on the PVC but cached providers may not
        - run: &init |
            log=$(mktemp)
            terragrunt init -input=false -no-color > "$log" 2>&1 || { cat "$log"; rm -f "$log"; exit 1; }
            rm -f "$log"
        # Visible output so plan errors reach the PR comment
        - run: terragrunt plan -input=false -no-color -out $PLANFILE
        - run:
            command: terragrunt show -json $PLANFILE > $SHOWFILE
            output: hide
        # Cost estimate is informational: a pricing API failure must not fail the plan
        - run: infracost diff --path $SHOWFILE --no-color || echo "Infracost estimate unavailable"
    apply:
      steps:
        - env:
            name: TG_ENV
            command: '[ "$BASE_BRANCH_NAME" = main ] && echo prod || echo develop'
        - env:
            name: TF_VAR_credentials
            command: 'echo "/tmp/gcp-$${TG_ENV}.json"'
        - env:
            name: TG_TF_PATH
            command: 'echo "$${ATLANTIS_TERRAFORM_DISTRIBUTION}$${ATLANTIS_TERRAFORM_VERSION}"'
        - env:
            name: TF_IN_AUTOMATION
            value: "true"
        - env:
            name: TG_LOG_FORMAT
            value: bare
        - run: *credentials
        - run: *init
        - run: terragrunt apply -input=false -no-color $PLANFILE

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
TG_VERSION="v1.2.1"
INFRACOST_VERSION="v0.10.47"
case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) arch=amd64 ;; aarch64) arch=arm64 ;; *) echo "unsupported arch"; exit 1 ;; esac
cd "$${INIT_SHARED_DIR}"
wget -q "https://github.com/gruntwork-io/terragrunt/releases/download/$${TG_VERSION}/terragrunt_linux_$${arch}"
wget -q -O - "https://github.com/gruntwork-io/terragrunt/releases/download/$${TG_VERSION}/SHA256SUMS" | grep " terragrunt_linux_$${arch}$" | sha256sum -c
mv "terragrunt_linux_$${arch}" terragrunt
chmod 755 terragrunt
wget -q "https://github.com/infracost/infracost/releases/download/$${INFRACOST_VERSION}/infracost-linux-$${arch}.tar.gz"
wget -q -O - "https://github.com/infracost/infracost/releases/download/$${INFRACOST_VERSION}/infracost-linux-$${arch}.tar.gz.sha256" | sha256sum -c
tar -xzf "infracost-linux-$${arch}.tar.gz"
rm "infracost-linux-$${arch}.tar.gz"
mv "infracost-linux-$${arch}" infracost
chmod 755 infracost

/hr/ghcr.io-bjw-s-labs-charts-immich-imm.doc:
Immich is a self-hosted photo and video backup solution.

For immich, there are multiple helm deployments:

  • immich-web
  • immich-server (this one)
  • immich-typesense
  • immich-machine-learning
  • immich-microservices

For redis and postgres, there are multiple helm charts:

  • Redis: app-template/redis, bitnami/redis
  • PostgreSQL: operator cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg, bitnami bitnami/postgresql
